source: ECCC CanGridP mlyV2, held 1991–2020 derived annual cell table
method: Marching squares in native x-major grid topology. Interpolate only between valid held cell centres. Geographic registration uses the supplied lon/lat values; x/y indices are not geographic degrees. Entire cells touching a nonland/missing vertex are excluded. Bands and isohyets share one generator; boundaries are not polygon smoothing of prior classes. Canada UI clips to the held national outline. No extrapolation or fabricated values.
limitations: The full-precision annual NPZ is not held in this checkout; annual CSV rounds to 0.1 mm and geolocation to 0.0001 degrees.

Normal HTTPS range retrieval of the current original NetCDF header was blocked by proxy Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden. No permission/security change or alternate route was used. Raw current land/monthly arrays were not independently rechecked.

Native valid-index mask, retained SHA, 100945 cells, reported source counts, valid extrema and no interpolation across missing/nonland are checked. Values and labels remain derived climate normals, not station measurements.
